name: .NET Build Test

# Builds every library and runs the unit tests, in the configuration the release workflow uses.
# It runs on a pull request that touches what the libraries or the tests are built from, so a
# failure that only shows on a runner is found in the pull request and not at release time.

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  PROJECTS: |
    src/Stride.CommunityToolkit/Stride.CommunityToolkit.csproj
    src/Stride.CommunityToolkit.Bepu/Stride.CommunityToolkit.Bepu.csproj
    src/Stride.CommunityToolkit.Bullet/Stride.CommunityToolkit.Bullet.csproj
    src/Stride.CommunityToolkit.DebugShapes/Stride.CommunityToolkit.DebugShapes.csproj
    src/Stride.CommunityToolkit.Effects/Stride.CommunityToolkit.Effects.csproj
    src/Stride.CommunityToolkit.ImGui/Stride.CommunityToolkit.ImGui.csproj
    src/Stride.CommunityToolkit.Shapes/Stride.CommunityToolkit.Shapes.csproj
    src/Stride.CommunityToolkit.Skyboxes/Stride.CommunityToolkit.Skyboxes.csproj
    src/Stride.CommunityToolkit.Windows/Stride.CommunityToolkit.Windows.csproj
    src/Stride.CommunityToolkit.Linux/Stride.CommunityToolkit.Linux.csproj
  TEST_PROJECT: tests/Stride.CommunityToolkit.Tests/Stride.CommunityToolkit.Tests.csproj

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'tests/Stride.CommunityToolkit.Tests/**'
      - 'tests/Directory.Build.*'
      # The test project also exercises the console launcher
      - 'tools/Stride.CommunityToolkit.Examples/**'
      - 'tools/Stride.CommunityToolkit.Examples.MetadataGenerator/**'
      - 'tools/ExamplesManifest.targets'
      - 'tools/Directory.Build.*'
      # The test project references this example
      - 'examples/code-only/E20_3D_CubeCollapse/**'
      - 'examples/Directory.Build.*'
      - 'build/HostRuntime.*'
      - 'Directory.Build.props'
      - '.github/workflows/dotnet-build-test.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

# A newer push to the same pull request replaces the run in progress
concurrency:
  group: build-test-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: windows-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout Stride Community Toolkit
      uses: actions/checkout@v7

    - name: .NET Setup
      uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v6
      with:
        dotnet-version: 10.0.x

    - name: Build projects
      run: |
        set -eo pipefail
        IFS=$'\n'
        for project in $PROJECTS; do
          project="${project//$'\r'/}"
          echo "::group::$project"
          dotnet restore "$project"
          dotnet build "$project" --no-restore -c Release
          echo "::endgroup::"
        done
      shell: bash

    - name: Test
      run: dotnet test ${{ env.TEST_PROJECT }} -c Release --logger "trx;LogFileName=tests.trx" --results-directory TestResults

    - name: Upload the test results
      if: failure()
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
      with:
        name: test-results
        path: TestResults
        if-no-files-found: ignore

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
